integrity: The exact minimum and its classical attaining witnesses are attributed to prior literature. New claim is uniqueness of the pair. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The sufficiency cutoff 5504798 is inherited from Wang–Xie–Zhao’s published analytic bound and is not claimed optimal. The result does not classify smaller orders or almost-minimizers; finite computations are supporting checks only.
title: Uniqueness of the asymptotic Farey inversion minimizer
